description: This file defines a function 'transformProps' that processes chart properties and data for a Superset plugin, specifically for an ag-grid table chart. It includes data transformation, formatting, and configuration logic, and references various utility modules and types.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if all data records have numeric or null/undefined values for a given key.

methods.name: isPositiveNumber
methods.description: Checks if a value is a positive number, considering null, undefined, or empty string as false.

methods.name: calculateDifferences
methods.description: Calculates the absolute and percentage difference between two numbers.

methods.name: processComparisonTotals
methods.description: Aggregates comparison totals, computing main and difference metrics.

methods.name: getComparisonColConfig
methods.description: Retrieves column configuration for comparison columns based on label and parent column key.

methods.name: getComparisonColFormatter
methods.description: Determines the formatter for comparison columns, considering currency and number formats.

methods.name: processComparisonDataRecords
methods.description: Transforms data records to include comparison metrics with differences and percentages.

methods.name: processComparisonColumns
methods.description: Generates comparison columns for metrics, including main, comparison, delta, and percentage columns.

methods.name: processDataRecords
methods.description: Processes raw data records, converting date fields to formatted date objects for sorting and display.

methods.name: processColumns
methods.description: Generates column metadata, including labels, formats, and data types, based on chart props and data.

methods.name: getPageSize
methods.description: Determines the page size for the table based on record count, column count, and optional page size setting.

methods.name: transformProps
methods.description: Main function that transforms chart properties and data into a format suitable for rendering the ag-grid table, including data processing, formatting, and configuration.
